name: HEICO Corp.
sector: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Makers

prime_pathway_loss.description: Share of mapped defense endpoints that lose all semiconductor-side reachability after this firm is removed from the supplied preprocessing graph.

network_fragmentation.description: Normalized increase in weak-component fragmentation and largest-component loss after firm removal.

backup_capacity_loss.description: Normalized proxy for corridor backup-capacity loss, based on semiconductor-side ancestors and defense-side descendants of the removed firm.

methodology.assumption: Static directed network removal with fixed substitution boundary
methodology.what_it_measures: Structural consequence indicators derived from the supplied semiconductor-defense preprocessing graph and centrality outputs.
methodology.what_it_does_not_measure: Probability of disruption, likelihood of attack, firm intent, financial risk, classified dependency, or the Cornell Chapter 4 M6 weighted-disruption score.
methodology.notes: The supplied archive did not include node_single_removal_impacts_full.csv; these scenarios are generated from the available centrality and network tables.
